temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth has been unusually curt with Keith over the past few days. When he asks if he upset her, Elizabeth says no, explains she is dealing with personal stuff, and apologizes if she seemed short.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth might be upset with him, possibly because of a misunderstanding or an unknown mistake he made.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Elizabeth's explanation disconfirms his suspicion that her curtness was about him. It shifts the cause to her personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is not upset with him; she is dealing with personal stress, and her short responses were not personal toward him.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Relieved but also concerned and sympathetic.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Be considerate, avoid pressing her, and stay open to supporting her if she wants to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Keith offers support and suggests a coffee break; Elizabeth accepts and thanks him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is dealing with personal stress and is not upset with him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Elizabeth's acceptance indicates she welcomes his support and is open to spending time with him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is receptive to his support, and a coffee break may help her.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Use the coffee break to listen to her and offer supportive company.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over coffee, Elizabeth shares more about her stresses, which seem severe. Keith suggests professional help; Elizabeth says she has thought about it but feels hesitant.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is under significant personal stress and has been receptive to his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; he learns her stress is severe and she is hesitant about professional help. His belief that professional help might benefit her strengthens, but so does his concern about offending her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Professional help could benefit Elizabeth, but she is hesitant, so he must be careful and respectful in how he discusses it.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, cautious, and worried about overstepping.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Gently encourage consideration of professional help without pressuring her, while continuing to offer support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth becomes slightly withdrawn after his suggestion. Keith apologizes in case he overstepped; Elizabeth says he did not overstep and that she appreciates his concern, but it is a lot to think about.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Professional help might benefit Elizabeth, but she is hesitant, and he worries his suggestion may have been too much.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; he initially interprets her withdrawal as possible embarrassment, but her reply reassures him that she did not feel overstepped and does appreciate his concern.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: He did not offend her; she appreciates his concern, but she is processing a lot and may need space.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Regretful at first, then reassured but still concerned.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Reassure Elizabeth of his support, avoid pushing the professional-help topic, and repair any discomfort.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth seems more open and appreciative of Keith's concern. She thanks him and says his support means a lot and makes her feel better knowing she has it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth appreciates his concern but has a lot to process; he is unsure how comfortable she fully feels.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; her openness and thanks confirm that she values his support and feels more comfortable around him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth values his support and feels better knowing she has it; their supportive relationship is positive and stable.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain the supportive relationship and remain available for chats or breaks together.
